Downtown Core & Waterfront.name: Downtown Core & Waterfront
Downtown Core & Waterfront.description: Pike Place-Third Avenue retail spine, office towers, and waterfront redevelopment core anchored by the Convention Center expansion and waterfront park rebuild.

South Lake Union.name: South Lake Union
South Lake Union.description: Amazon headquarters biotech and life-science district with the region's densest construction crane count and streetcar-served mixed-use infill.

Belltown/Denny Triangle.name: Belltown/Denny Triangle
Belltown/Denny Triangle.description: Condo towers, nightlife corridors, and convention-center expansion infill between Denny Park and Elliott Bay.

Capitol Hill/First Hill.name: Capitol Hill/First Hill
Capitol Hill/First Hill.description: Dense mixed-use nightlife and medical-institutional ridge including Swedish Medical Center, Seattle University, and Link light-rail station areas.

Pioneer Square/Chinatown-ID.name: Pioneer Square/Chinatown-ID
Pioneer Square/Chinatown-ID.description: Historic loft and stadium-district adaptive reuse with light-rail gateway traffic, Climate Pledge Arena demand, and SODO industrial edge dynamics.

Ballard.name: Ballard
Ballard.description: Maritime-industrial heritage converting to Nordic-themed retail, brewery corridors, and multifamily development along Ballard Avenue and Leary Way.

Fremont/Wallingford.name: Fremont/Wallingford
Fremont/Wallingford.description: Eccentric creative corridor under the Aurora Bridge with tech satellite offices, canal-front retail, and Google campus expansion.

University District/Roosevelt.name: University District/Roosevelt
University District/Roosevelt.description: University of Washington anchor economy with Link-rail transit-oriented upzoning along Roosevelt Avenue and the Ave commercial spine.

Queen Anne/Magnolia.name: Queen Anne/Magnolia
Queen Anne/Magnolia.description: Hilltop residential enclaves overlooking Uptown arts retail, Seattle Center, and Interbay rail-served industrial land.

Northgate/Lake City.name: Northgate/Lake City
Northgate/Lake City.description: Transit-oriented mall redevelopment into the NHL Kraken practice facility and ped-friendly district plus north-end affordable infill frontier.

Downtown Bellevue.name: Downtown Bellevue
Downtown Bellevue.description: Second CBD of the metro with Amazon and Microsoft towers, Bellevue Square luxury retail, and East Link light-rail expansion.

Kirkland Waterfront.name: Kirkland Waterfront
Kirkland Waterfront.description: Lakeside Google-corridor office market with MarinaPark civic frontage and boutique downtown retail along Lake Washington.

Redmond/Overlake.name: Redmond/Overlake
Redmond/Overlake.description: Microsoft campus belt plus light-rail-linked downtown village redevelopment along the Redmond Technology Station corridor.

Woodinville Wine Country.name: Woodinville Wine Country
Woodinville Wine Country.description: Wine-country tourism district with Hollywood Hill tasting rooms, Tourist Mill light-industrial, and SR-522 logistics frontage.

Issaquah/Sammamish.name: Issaquah/Sammamish
Issaquah/Sammamish.description: I-90 master-planned growth engine combining Grand Ridge tech campuses, Highlands rooftops, and Costco headquarters roots.

West Seattle/Junction.name: West Seattle/Junction
West Seattle/Junction.description: Beach-community retail node on California Avenue SW with bridge-constrained supply dynamics and Alki waterfront demand.

Beacon Hill/Columbia City.name: Beacon Hill/Columbia City
Beacon Hill/Columbia City.description: Link light-rail multicultural corridor with rapid Rainier Valley gentrification, landmark Columbia City historic district, and upzoned station areas.

Georgetown/South Park.name: Georgetown/South Park
Georgetown/South Park.description: Artist-industrial enclave amid Duwamish heavy manufacturing, airport freight corridors, and Airport Way adaptive reuse.

Renton/Southcenter.name: Renton/Southcenter
Renton/Southcenter.description: Boeing 737 plant plus Southcenter regional mall and the I-405 hotel-office cluster on the Cedar River waterfront.

Kent Valley.name: Kent Valley
Kent Valley.description: Puget Sound's largest warehouse and logistics submarket along Valley Freeway and the BNSF rail line.
